# `miniApp` (Layout)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

A module running as a compact app: its initial page, with its own state, actions and values, and its own navigator, so its routes (pages, sheets, dialogs) open inside its box (a phone frame), which must have a bounded size (e.g. inside `expanded` or a `sizedBox`, not `scroll`). It inherits the theme unless it has a style/ folder. `module:` names a folder in modules/ (`miniApp: food` is short for `miniApp: {module: food}`); `project:` instead names a value returning a `metacodeProject` (a whole app as files, usually from the state): it is compiled in the app and runs sandboxed (no access to this app's state or actions), reloading in place, state kept, every time the project changes. To use one part of a module instead (a component, a value, an action), write `<module>.<name>` anywhere a name goes: `food.MenuCard`, `food.addItem`.
Shorthand: `miniApp: food` (sets `module`).

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `module` | module |  |
| `project` | value | a value returning metacodeProject; give either module or project |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
